title: TGT Cymru: TransformGov Talks x Transform Wales November 2026
description:
Hosted by Transform Wales.

Our first speaker was Rachel Meese, Head of UCD at Digital Health and Care Wales, on building a user-centred design team in the Welsh public sector.

That was followed by Andy Regan, Head of Nesta Cymru, on why government should test and learn rather than rely on big up-front plans.

Then finally Omar Idris, Head of Design at Perago, on how a test-and-learn approach helps teams quickly find what works, with less risk.
